validity.researcher_notes: Existence: real, government-approved project. Found and read the underlying primary source itself via the Wayback Machine: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Development and Reform Commission approval notice 桂发改能源《2018》1484号 (2018-12-25, signed 2018-12-21), '关于广西天然气支线管网项目桂林-灵川-兴安天然气支线管道工程项目核准的批复' (approval of the Guilin-Lingchuan-Xing'an gas branch pipeline project). This is the same government notice the gem.wiki page's own citations #39/#40 point to (gas.in-en.com news + the same fgw.gxzf.gov.cn approval page, respectively) — I read the primary document directly rather than relying on the secondary press writeups. Classification: correct — the approval doc itself calls it a 天然气支线管道 (natural gas branch/transmission pipeline), matching GEM's PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas. Duplicate: checked against the other 42 in-scope rows; the only spec-lookalike is P7662 'Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu Branch' (also ~100km, dia 273.1mm) — but that is a documented, differently-routed line (south of Guilin toward Yangshuo/Lipu, its own current_ref t2198137.shtml) and independently corroborated by a 2025 news item (Guilin-Yangshuo-Laipu branch completed testing Dec 2025, ~107km) that has nothing to do with the Lingchuan/Xing'an route (north of Guilin). Not a duplicate. Attribution: Owner1 'Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd' matches the approval doc's named 项目建设单位 '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' exactly, as does QCCOwner(业主单位) on the operators/owners tab. Location matches: the approval doc states the route passes through 临桂区、灵川县、兴安县 (Lingui District, Lingchuan County, Xing'an County), consistent with GEM's Start/EndLocation (Lingui District start, Xing'an County end) — 3 stations built/rebuilt: Guilin distribution station (renovated), new Lingchuan and Xing'an distribution stations. Caveat: GEM's EndLocation calls the Xing'an facility a 'Terminal station' while the source calls it a 分输站 (distribution station) — same facility, minor label difference, not a substantive error. Caveat 2: the sheet's own current [ref] for Fuel/PipelineType (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/.../t10409858.shtml) is a dead link with no Wayback capture (checked archive.org's availability API — zero snapshots) — could not verify that specific citation, but the values themselves are independently confirmed via the sibling approval doc t10409787 read above.

validity.recommendation: Correct Diameter from 273.10mm to 271.3mm (digit transposition against the primary approval document).
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records Diameter=273.10mm. The Guangxi DRC approval document (桂发改能源《2018》1484号, read via Wayback) states verbatim: '新建100公里天然气管道,管径D271.3mm,设计压力4.0MPa,设计输量为2.2亿立方米/年' (new 100km gas pipeline, diameter D271.3mm, design pressure 4.0MPa, design capacity 220 million m3/year). Length (100km), CapacityUnits/Capacity (0.22 bcm/y) and SegmentCost (36148.14万元 = RMB 361,480,000) all match GEM exactly, but Diameter does not: the source says 271.3mm, GEM has 273.10mm — the two digits are transposed (271.3 vs 273.1). This is very likely a data-entry transcription slip rather than two genuinely different pipes (a 271.3mm OD line is an unusual but plausible metric-adjacent size; 273.1mm/273mm is the far more common nominal size elsewhere in this same network's rows, which may be exactly why the transposition went unnoticed). Flagging rather than silently overwriting per standing rules — recommend Diameter -> 271.3mm.

validity.recommendation: Correct ProposalYear from 2021 to 2018 (ProposalMonth from 7 to 12), or verify against an earlier proposal filing if one exists.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records ProposalYear=2021, ProposalMonth=7 (cell has no ref — MISSING_REF). The only dated milestones I can find for this specific project are all 2018: the Guilin DRC's request to the provincial DRC (市发改报字《2018》366号) and the builder's own approval request (广投管网报《2018》212号), both referenced in, and the provincial approval itself dated 2018-12-25 (signed 2018-12-21, doc 桂发改能源《2018》1484号). A companion news write-up (gas.in-en.com, could not pass url_verifier — 403 to our UA — but its content is echoed in search-engine snippets) is dated 2019-01-18 and reports the same approval. I found nothing dated 2021 tied to this project's proposal stage; several of the wiki page's OTHER footnotes for this same article happen to carry 'Retrieved 2021-09-29' access-date metadata (a pattern repeated across many citations on this wiki page), which is a plausible explanation for how a contributor could have mis-entered an access/retrieval date as the ProposalYear. Flagging as a likely data-entry error rather than fabricating a replacement ref — recommend correcting to 2018 (December) pending a source search specifically for that field, or leaving it to the refs leg to source properly if an earlier, genuine 2021 proposal event turns out to exist that I have not found.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's existing Status[ref] (a 2021-07-22 Guilin DRC 2021 departmental budget explanation, archived as an image screenshot at archive.org/details/2023-09-27-122841 that I could not OCR/read directly) is the most recent evidence tying this project to 'shelved' that I could find or corroborate — 5 years old as of this review (2026-07). Read the project's own approval document (桂发改能源《2018》1484号, 2018-12-25): clause 10 states that if construction has not begun within 2 years of approval (i.e. by ~Dec 2020), the builder must request a single, max-1-year extension (i.e. by ~Dec 2021) or the approval lapses. I found no evidence anywhere — news search in Chinese for the project name, for '灵川分输站'/'兴安分输站' (the two new distribution stations named in the approval), and for construction/cancellation-related terms (建成/通气/投产/取消/停建/撤销) — that construction ever started, that an extension was granted, or that the project was formally cancelled. That silence, combined with the approval's own 2(+1)-year use-it-or-lose-it clause expiring around Dec 2020/2021, is consistent with the project quietly lapsing right around when the cited 2021 Guilin budget document apparently flagged it as shelved. Applying the dormancy rule (shelved >=4y -> cancelled) since I can find nothing newer than 2021 and it is now 2026 — proposing Status=cancelled, ShelvedCancelledType=Presumed, with no fabricated ref per standing rule 2. This is an inference, not a hard finding; if the 2021 budget-document image can be OCR'd/read by a human, it may directly say more (e.g. explicit cancellation language, or a revival) that should supersede this.

summary: P4726 (Guilin-Lingchuan-Xing'an Branch): real, correctly classified/owned/located government-approved project (primary approval doc 桂发改能源《2018》1484号 read via Wayback confirms Length/Capacity/SegmentCost/Owner/Location) but Diameter looks transposed (271.3mm per source vs GEM's 273.10mm) and ProposalYear looks like a data-entry slip (2021 vs the project's actual 2018 approval); no evidence found of construction ever starting past the approval's own 2(+1)-year lapse clause, so proposing a stale-dormancy Status change from shelved to cancelled (Presumed, no ref).
